text:
Elena (CFO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A re: runway and spend controls. I wanted to capture answers here and surface a few next steps.
Diego (Eng): thanks — can you clarify current runway in months? heard different numbers in the room.
Elena (CFO): Yes — based on current committed revenue and planned spend, our base plan runway is ~16 months. That assumes no major changes to hiring cadence and delivery of the current sales funnel.
Nina (Product): is that with or without additional Dedicated commitments (reserved capacity sales)?
Elena (CFO): Conservative plan includes the committed Dedicated contracts we have signed to date. New large Reserved deals (>$500k ARR) are modeled separately in upside scenarios.
Marta (Hiring): does this mean we pause roles? we need to know for hiring pipeline.
Elena (CFO): Not a hard freeze. We are instituting role-level prioritization: only roles tagged "mission-critical" by the hiring committee move forward immediately. Others will be reviewed weekly.
Marta (Hiring): got it — we'll push non-critical offers into pending state and notify candidates.
Diego (Eng): any changes to procurement approvals for infra (GPU nodes / cloud commits)?
Asha (FinanceOps): yes — new thresholds effective immediately: purchases or commitments < $25k — product/eng budget owner sign-off; $25k-$150k — budget owner + finance manager; > $150k — budget owner + finance director + CFO review.
Diego (Eng): and for multi-year committed instances (e.g., 3yr reserved GPUs) which have large upfront cash impact?
Elena (CFO): those fall into > $150k. We'll require a short ROI doc (1 page) and a fallback plan if utilization is lower than projected. Finance will fast-track vendor negotiations for strategic needs.
Nina (Product): are we still green-lighting experiments that increase short-term burn but unlock major product differentiation?
Sam (CEO): short answer: yes for a small set. We will continue to fund high-ROI product bets. The bar is higher: we expect measurable milestones at 6-8 weeks.
Diego (Eng): any specific cost-optimization targets for eng infra?
CostBot: automated message — "Optimize initiative: target 12% infra run-rate reduction over next 3 months via batching, spot instances, and model quantization pilots."
Elena (CFO): That initiative is active. We expect teams to partner with Eng-ML to apply Redwood Optimize recommendations; saving plans will be tracked against team budgets.
Asha (FinanceOps): practical note on procurement requests: please use the Procurement form (link: https://redwood.internal/procure) and include: vendor, term, expected ARR impact (if any), and GL code. Requests without the form will be returned.
Diego (Eng): is there a fast lane if we need to accept a customer-required on-prem appliance that has long lead time?
Elena (CFO): Yes — mark the request "customer critical" and loop in Sales + Solutions + FinanceOps. We'll triage within 48 hours.
Nina (Product): question on credits/discounts for Dedicated capacity — are we changing pricing to be more conservative?
Sam (CEO): no broad price raise but we're tightening discount bands for new contracts. Finance and Sales will publish updated playbooks this week.
Marta (Hiring): headcount budgeting cadence? will we still run quarterly HC forecasting?
Asha (FinanceOps): quarterly headcount forecast remains, but we'll add mid-quarter checkpoints when we hit 70% of planned spend vs. forecast.
Diego (Eng): any changes to employee expense policy? travel? conferences?
Elena (CFO): capped travel budgets per role band for the next two quarters. Conference attendance requires manager + director approval; vendor-sponsored travel must be pre-cleared with FinanceOps.
Diego (Eng): understood.
Nina (Product): will there be visibility into per-route cost/latency breakdowns to help product owners make tradeoffs?
Sam (CEO): yes — Redwood Console will expose per-route token cost and latency metrics by end of next sprint. Product owners should subscribe to the console dashboards.
Diego (Eng): thanks — that helps prioritize optimizations.
Asha (FinanceOps): next steps: 1) Finance will post an FAQ doc in #finance by EOD tomorrow; 2) Procurement form link and approval matrix updated; 3) Hiring committee will publish prioritization rubric.
Elena (CFO): please drop any follow-up Qs here. If you have a sensitive ask, DM me or Asha. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Sam (CEO): appreciate the clear follow-up. We're balancing growth and prudence — keep feedback coming.
Diego (Eng): quick ask — can Eng get a point contact in Finance for GPU budgeting?
Asha (FinanceOps): that's me. I'll set up weekly office hours for infra and model ops budget syncs. Invite will go out.
Diego (Eng): perfect, thanks.
CostBot: automated note — "Budget snapshot (updated): cash runway 16 months (base), stress scenario 10 months if growth decelerates 30%."
Nina (Product): one last: will we preserve budget for experiments tied to top OKRs?
Sam (CEO): yes — OKR-aligned bets are prioritized. We expect crisp milestones and regular check-ins.
Elena (CFO): end of thread recap: runway ~16 months base; new approval thresholds; targeted infra savings; hiring prioritization; procurement form required. I'll post the short FAQ and link here when ready.
Diego (Eng): thanks — helpful.
Marta (Hiring): thanks — we'll update candidates and hiring docs.
Asha (FinanceOps): FAQ and procurement updates inbound.
Elena (CFO): closing — if any teams need an accelerated review for a customer or critical hire, @mention me and Asha.
